title: Configuration compliance policies
description: The contract for policies/compliance.yml. Replaces the Cerberus validators of the 2019-2021 mini-course. Semantics are documented in docs/compliance.md and plugins/filter/compliance.py.

id.description: Stable, readable identifier. Appears in reports and in the playbook's failure message.

description.description: Why the policy exists, in one sentence.

groups.description: Inventory groups the policy applies to. Omit to apply to every host on the platform.

parent.description: Regex, full-line match, selecting top-level blocks. Omit for a top-level line.

config.description: Regex, full-line match, for the line that must be present or absent.
